NeedsVsWantsGame.title: The Treasure Box and Necessities
NeedsVsWantsGame.subtitle: Discover the difference between needs and wants!
NeedsVsWantsGame.itemsTitle: Drag items to the correct boxes
NeedsVsWantsGame.dragWillEnable: Drag & drop will be enabled shortly

voice.welcome: Hello! I'm your voice assistant! Today we play with two magic boxes: one for needs and one for treasures. Needs are things we need to live, treasures are things that make us happy!
voice.instructions: Drag each item to the right box. If it's something we need to live, put it in needs. If it's something that makes us happy but not essential, put it in treasures!
voice.reflection: Great job! You learned that needs are fundamental like fuel for a car, while wants make life more colorful like confetti!

water.name: water
water.explanation: Without water we couldn't live, it's a fundamental need!

food.name: food
food.explanation: Food gives us energy to live, it's essential!

house.name: house
house.explanation: The house protects us and keeps us safe, it's a need!

clothes.name: clothes
clothes.explanation: Clothes protect us from cold, they are necessary!

bed.name: bed
bed.explanation: The bed helps us rest well, it's important!

icecream.name: ice cream
icecream.explanation: Ice cream is delicious but we can live without it, it's a want!

videogame.name: video game
videogame.explanation: Video games are fun but not essential for living!

toy.name: toy
toy.explanation: Toys are fun but not indispensable!

chocolate.name: chocolate
chocolate.explanation: Chocolate is tasty but we can live without it!

balloon.name: balloon
balloon.explanation: Balloons are colorful but we don't need them to live!

reflection.title: Great job!
reflection.message: You learned the difference between needs and wants!
reflection.needsDescription: These are fundamental things we need to live: food, water, house, clothes.
reflection.wantsDescription: These are things that make us happy but not essential: toys, sweets, entertainment.
